package moba

import (
	"context"
	"errors"
	svcmatch "github.com/tjbdwanghaibo/roost-core/service/match"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"
)

// 匹配队列用 service/match 的正式领域实现与内存存储；服务 RPC、Redis 存储与认证不在本用例内，
// 接法参考 game-demo 的匹配服务（wiring/match）与机器人。
func TestMOBAMatchmakingAdmissionCancellationAndCommit(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	now := time.Unix(1800000000, 0)
	store, err := svcmatch.NewMemoryStore(svcmatch.Config{Now: func() time.Time { return now }, TicketTTL: time.Second})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	queue := svcmatch.Queue{Mode: "moba-practice", GroupSize: 2, Partition: "local-owner"}
	a, b := svcmatch.Subject{Kind: "player", ID: 9001}, svcmatch.Subject{Kind: "player", ID: 9002}
	ta, err := store.Enqueue(ctx, queue, a, "join-a")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	again, err := store.Enqueue(ctx, queue, a, "join-a")
	if err != nil || again.ID != ta.ID {
		t.Fatal("replayed queue join duplicated ticket")
	}
	tb, err := store.Enqueue(ctx, queue, b, "join-b")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := store.Cancel(ctx, queue, tb.ID, a); !errors.Is(err, svcmatch.ErrNotPermitted) {
		t.Fatalf("another player cancelled ticket: %v", err)
	}
	if _, err := store.Cancel(ctx, queue, tb.ID, b); err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	if _, err := store.Commit(ctx, queue, []string{ta.ID, tb.ID}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("cancelled participant started a match")
	}
	tb, err = store.Enqueue(ctx, queue, b, "join-b-new")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	candidates, err := store.Candidates(ctx, queue, 8)
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	group, formed, err := (svcmatch.FirstComeGrouping{}).Group(queue, candidates)
	if err != nil || !formed || len(group) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("pair was not formed")
	}
	var wg sync.WaitGroup
	results := make([]svcmatch.Match, 2)
	errs := make([]error, 2)
	for i := range 2 {
		wg.Add(1)
		go func(i int) {
			defer wg.Done()
			results[i], errs[i] = store.Commit(ctx, queue, []string{group[0].ID, group[1].ID})
		}(i)
	}
	wg.Wait()
	// 同一票集合的 Commit 是幂等：并发调用都可以成功回复，但必须指向同一 Match，不能按回复数判断开局次数。
	for _, err := range errs {
		if err != nil {
			t.Fatal(err)
		}
	}
	if results[0].ID == "" || results[0].ID != results[1].ID || len(results[0].Members) != 2 {
		t.Fatal("same ticket set created different matches")
	}
	if length, err := store.QueueLength(ctx, queue); err != nil || length != 0 {
		t.Fatal("matched players stayed queued")
	}
	c := svcmatch.Subject{Kind: "player", ID: 9003}
	tc, err := store.Enqueue(ctx, queue, c, "join-c")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatal(err)
	}
	now = now.Add(2 * time.Second)
	if candidates, err := store.Candidates(ctx, queue, 8); err != nil || len(candidates) != 0 {
		t.Fatal("expired player entered candidate pool")
	}
	if _, err := store.Commit(ctx, queue, []string{tc.ID, ta.ID}); err == nil {
		t.Fatal("expired ticket entered a battle")
	}
}
